reuse.why: No guard existed; it adds one assertBankAccountNotLinked helper and reuses it in every provider link function rather than re-implementing the query.

duplication.why: The rule (query plus message) is written once; the five call sites only pass their provider, account id and upgradingId.

placement.why: Sits next to the link functions in accounts/app.ts before any bank or account write; accounts/link.ts, which holds the shared link helper findOrCreateBank, would be an equally natural home.

scope.why: Only the guard, its five calls and focused handler tests covering each required case.

maintainability.why: Typed provider parameter, one definition of what counts as linked, and the re-link exception handled in the query.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, called first by linkGoCardlessAccount, linkSimpleFinAccount, linkPluggyAiAccount, linkAkahuAccount and linkEnableBankingAccount
